# ShineleeBox

> Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd. is a custom paper packaging manufacturer serving global brands. The company specializes in rigid gift boxes, advent calendars, interactive packaging, keepsake boxes, and greeting cards.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.slpack.net/): Company overview, manufacturing strengths, and inquiry form.
- [About ShineleeBox](https://www.slpack.net/about.html): Factory history, capabilities, and certifications.
- [Contact](https://www.slpack.net/contact.html): Request custom packaging quotations, samples, and dielines.

## Featured Chocolate Packaging

- [Custom Book-Style Chocolate Gift Box with 12-Cavity Tray](https://www.slpack.net/products/custom-book-style-chocolate-gift-box.html): Custom book-style chocolate gift box with a hinged cover and fitted 12-cavity tray. OEM rigid packaging with branded paper, foil and food-safe primary-pack options.
- [Luxury Double-Door Book-Style Chocolate Presentation Box](https://www.slpack.net/products/double-door-book-style-chocolate-box.html): Luxury double-door chocolate presentation box with a central 16-piece tray. Custom rigid packaging for premium confectionery brands, gifting and retail collections.
- [Luxury Lid-and-Base Chocolate Gift Box with 20-Cavity Tray](https://www.slpack.net/products/luxury-lid-base-chocolate-box.html): Luxury lid-and-base chocolate gift box with a fitted 20-cavity tray and premium foil branding. Custom two-piece rigid packaging for chocolate manufacturers.
- [Custom Window Lid Chocolate Gift Box with Geometric Display](https://www.slpack.net/products/window-lid-chocolate-gift-box.html): Custom window chocolate gift box with a geometric clear display lid and fitted 12-piece tray. Original rigid packaging for premium confectionery retail.
- [Two-Drawer Chocolate Gift Box with Ribbon Pulls](https://www.slpack.net/products/two-drawer-chocolate-gift-box.html): Two-drawer chocolate gift box with ribbon pulls and separate fitted trays. Custom rigid packaging for layered assortments, tasting sets and festive gifts.
- [Custom Heart-Shaped Chocolate Gift Box with Fitted Tray](https://www.slpack.net/products/heart-shaped-chocolate-box.html): Custom heart-shaped chocolate gift box with a fitted tray for Valentine, wedding and anniversary collections. OEM custom-shape rigid packaging with foil branding.
- [Flower-Petal Chocolate Gift Box with Six Opening Compartments](https://www.slpack.net/products/flower-petal-chocolate-gift-box.html): Innovative flower-petal chocolate gift box with six radial compartments and a central presentation well. Original custom rigid packaging for premium bonbons.
- [24-Day Chocolate Advent Calendar Box with Drawers](https://www.slpack.net/products/24-day-chocolate-advent-calendar-box.html): Custom 24-day chocolate advent calendar box with individual pull-out drawers and book-style cover. OEM holiday packaging for chocolate countdown collections.
- [Two-Tier Rotating Chocolate Presentation Box](https://www.slpack.net/products/two-tier-rotating-chocolate-box.html): Two-tier rotating chocolate presentation box with offset trays and fitted compartments. Custom interactive rigid packaging for luxury confectionery gifts.

## Sourcing Facts

- Manufacturer: Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd.
- Brand: ShineleeBox
- Founded: 2005; own factory established in 2011
- Facility: 20,000 square metres
- Typical minimum order quantity shown on the website: from 50 pieces
- Contact: info@slpack.net | +86 188 1884 0878
- Structural material used for rigid boxes: high-density greyboard, not MDF wood board

## Packaging Knowledge Base

- [All Packaging Knowledge Articles](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/): Direct, factory-reviewed answers to custom packaging procurement questions.
- [What Is Keepsake Packaging?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/what-is-keepsake-packaging.html): Keepsake packaging is a durable presentation package intentionally designed to be retained and reused after the original product is removed. Its value comes from continued utility, emotional meaning or display quality—not simply from using thicker board. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [What Is Unboxing Experience Packaging?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/what-is-unboxing-experience-packaging.html): Unboxing experience packaging is packaging engineered to control how a recipient opens, discovers and removes a product. It combines structure, reveal sequence, tactile cues, messaging and product access; decoration alone does not create a good unboxing experience. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [What Makes Luxury Packaging Worth Keeping?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/what-makes-luxury-packaging-worth-keeping.html): Luxury packaging becomes worth keeping when it offers lasting utility, emotional relevance or display value and remains durable enough for repeated handling. High cost, heavy board or decorative finishes alone do not make a package retainable. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Design Reusable Packaging for Luxury Brands](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-reusable-packaging-for-luxury-brands.html): To design reusable luxury packaging, define the secondary use first, then engineer durability, removable or adaptable inserts, suitable closures and graphics that remain relevant after the original product is removed. Validate reuse with physical testing. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [Custom Packaging MOQ Explained](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/custom-packaging-moq-explained.html): A custom packaging MOQ is the smallest production quantity a supplier can make economically for a specific specification. It is affected by setup time, material minimums, tooling, printing, finishing, assembly and quality control—not just the number of finished boxes. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How Much Does Custom Luxury Packaging Cost?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-much-does-custom-luxury-packaging-cost.html): Custom luxury packaging has no reliable universal price per box. Cost depends on dimensions, quantity, board and wrap materials, insert, printing, finishes, assembly, packing and freight. A meaningful quotation requires a defined specification. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How Long Does Custom Packaging Production Take?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-long-does-custom-packaging-production-take.html): Standard custom packaging production normally takes about 20–25 days after the physical sample and final artwork are approved. Total project lead time is longer because it also includes briefing, engineering, 5–7 day sampling, revisions, packing and transport. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [Rigid Box vs Folding Carton](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/rigid-box-vs-folding-carton.html): A rigid box uses thick non-collapsing board that is usually wrapped and delivered assembled; a folding carton uses thinner paperboard that is printed, die-cut and typically shipped flat. Rigid boxes emphasize presentation and strength, while folding cartons usually offer lower weight and packing efficiency.
- [Magnetic Box vs Drawer Box](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/magnetic-box-vs-drawer-box.html): A magnetic box usually opens like a book with a hinged lid and concealed magnets; a drawer box uses an outer sleeve and sliding inner tray. Magnetic boxes create a broad reveal, while drawer boxes create a controlled pull-out reveal and can offer strong product containment.
- [How to Design Packaging From an AI Concept](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-packaging-from-an-ai-concept.html): To manufacture packaging from an AI concept, treat the image as a visual brief—not a technical drawing. A packaging engineer must define dimensions, panels, joints, openings, inserts, materials, tolerances and finishing, then validate the interpretation with a physical sample. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How Packaging Structural Engineering Works](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-packaging-structural-engineering-works.html): Packaging structural engineering converts product and user requirements into a manufacturable physical system. It defines geometry, board construction, joints, openings, supports, insert retention, tolerances, assembly and interaction with the shipping pack. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Create Luxury PR Packaging](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-create-luxury-pr-packaging.html): Luxury PR packaging should organize the complete campaign set, communicate the launch story in a deliberate sequence and survive parcel distribution. Start with every product and accessory, then design the insert, reveal, messaging and transport pack as one system. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Design Premium Perfume Packaging](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-premium-perfume-packaging.html): Premium perfume packaging should be engineered from the filled bottle, cap and accessories. The insert must control movement without scuffing the bottle, provide comfortable removal and support the intended opening experience inside a suitable transport pack. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [Best Packaging Structures for Skincare Gift Sets](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/best-packaging-structures-for-skincare-gift-sets.html): The best skincare gift-set structure is the one that supports every filled product, presents the routine in a clear sequence and fits the brand’s packing and shipping workflow. Magnetic, drawer, lid-and-base and foldable rigid boxes each suit different priorities. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Design Chocolate Gift Packaging](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-chocolate-gift-packaging.html): Design chocolate gift packaging from the exact chocolate dimensions, piece count, arrangement and wrapping method. The rigid presentation box and the food-contact tray or liner should be specified separately, then tested with the real chocolates and intended distribution conditions. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Design Premium Dates Packaging](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-premium-dates-packaging.html): Premium dates packaging should be designed from the date variety, individual dimensions, piece count, net weight and arrangement. Because equal weights can occupy different volumes, final capacity must be confirmed with a filled physical sample. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [How to Design an Advent Calendar Box](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-to-design-an-advent-calendar-box.html): To design an Advent calendar box, freeze the complete product assortment, map each item to a numbered cavity, engineer product retention and removal, then approve the structure before final artwork. A packed prototype is essential because one incorrect cavity can affect the whole calendar.
- [What Is Interactive Packaging?](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/what-is-interactive-packaging.html): Interactive packaging is packaging that prompts or responds to user action beyond basic opening and product removal. Interaction can be mechanical, sensory, electronic or connected—for example drawers, layered reveals, light, sound, video or NFC-linked content. Final specifications should be confirmed against the actual product, a physical sample and the intended packing and distribution method.
- [Video Box vs Traditional Gift Box](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/video-box-vs-traditional-gift-box.html): A video box integrates a screen, controls, speaker and power system into the packaging, while a traditional gift box relies on structure, print and physical reveal. Video boxes deliver richer communication but add cost, weight, testing, charging, transport and end-of-life responsibilities.
- [How Reusable Packaging Improves Brand Recall](https://www.slpack.net/knowledge/how-reusable-packaging-improves-brand-recall.html): Reusable packaging can support brand recall by keeping the brand and product story visible after purchase and by associating the package with a useful or meaningful activity. The effect is not automatic; it depends on actual retention, frequency of use, relevance and branding.

Use the linked product and application pages as the source of truth for product-specific materials, structures, finishing options, minimum order quantities, and lead times. Contact ShineleeBox for project-specific pricing and specifications.
